links.outcome: Readability of chatbot EEG responses measured by Automated Readability Index
links.effect: ChatGPT ARI 17.41 ± 2.38, less readable than Copilot (11.14 ± 2.60, p < .001) and Gemini (14.16 ± 3.33); all above plain-language levels.
links.quote: ChatGPT text (ARI - mean ± SD 17.41 ± 2.38) was less readable than Copilot (ARI -mean ± SD 11.14 ± 2.60) (p < .001) and Gemini (ARI - mean ± SD 14.16 ± 3.33).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLM chatbots answering EEG questions across accuracy, completeness, readability, and inter-rater agreement among clinical neurophysiology staff.
